transport: authenticated local HTTP RPC including service/engine; excludes DSH generation

method.cold_definition: first query of each mode after daemon restart; OS file cache is not flushed

limits: One short synthetic run, not hours/days soak
Small corpus, not hundreds of GB
OS file cache may remain warm after daemon restart

validation_history.pre_fix_concurrent_run: An earlier run failed on its first index_status after paused restart with a sanitized ServiceError; the original server traceback was unavailable.
validation_history.confirmed_defect: Source review identified a coverage-cache invalidation race. A deterministic regression test failed before the local-snapshot fix with TypeError: NoneType is not a mapping, and passed afterward.
validation_history.diagnostic_restart_probe: A separate repeated-paused-restart diagnostic completed six iterations before a stop exceeded the 15-second timeout. The process was gone when subsequently inspected and no traceback was captured; this one-off symptom is not claimed resolved.
validation_history.post_fix_result: This final ordinary run passed all checks without adding retries around failed RPC calls; 25 of 25 chunks and vectors converged and the daemon stopped cleanly.

subsequent_windows_stop_followup.defect_proven: A Windows read handle can block the one-shot owned-state deletion, leaving service.json after daemon teardown. A real-handle test reproduced stop timeout before the fix and passed after it.
subsequent_windows_stop_followup.fix: Bounded ownership-checked deletion retries while service.lock is held
